_doc: GHI #741 cutover snapshot (shrink-ratchet; never add to silence a fresh violation). AGENTS.md § Persona has always declared 'Every agent frame MUST include a Persona', but no validator ever witnessed that MUST for ADRs — while the sibling section `## Why foundation tier?` has been mechanically enforced since OBPI-0.0.35-04. Two failure shapes reach this roster. (1) SECTION ABSENT — 40 of these 44 ADRs carry no `## Persona` heading at all; they predate the template section. Having no token to grep for, they were invisible to the `grep -rln '{persona}'` sweep that opened the investigation, which reported 5 affected files against a true population of 44. Only running the gate over an EMPTY roster surfaces the real set — a roster-aware sweep hides whatever is already exempt, and doing that once here silently dropped 4 members before the error was caught. Regenerate this file that way or not at all. (2) TOKEN RESIDUE — the remaining 4 render the literal string `{persona}`: `render_template` formats through `SafeDict`, whose `__missing__` returns the key as its own literal token, and `_render_adr_by_kind` never passed a `persona` kwarg, so every non-pool ADR scaffolded through `gz plan create` wrote scaffold residue into a mandatory section that no substance test recognised as scaffolding. 40 of the 44 are Validated and 2 more Completed — they passed Gate 5 human attestation this way. Backfilling persona prose into them now would be retroactive authorship of attested Layer-1 canon: inventing a behavioral frame nobody declared at the time and seating it inside an artifact an operator already witnessed. They are tolerated (persona population waived, every other contract still enforced), never laundered as authored. Three entries — ADR-0.1.0, ADR-0.15.0, ADR-0.16.0 — are a different problem wearing this one's clothes: their canonical files carry no frontmatter, no Intent/Decision/Consequences, zero ledger events, and no row in the ADR status index (ADR-0.16.0's canonical file is a bare 'Tidy First Plan'). They are stub packages, not ADRs missing a section; tracked separately, listed here only so this gate does not block on them. The set is closed: `audit_persona_witness` is fail-closed from this commit forward, its detector strips HTML author-prompts and `{token}` residue before testing for substance, and `gz plan create` now emits an author-prompt the gate catches instead of a token it could not. No new ADR can ever need an entry here. Entries drain only when an ADR is superseded, withdrawn, or given a persona by someone with standing to author one; the count may only decrease. Do NOT read a listed ADR as carrying a persona — it is evidence of the opposite.
